title: Account Age and the Timing of Limits and Levels Callbacks — Personal Sender Account
content:
For a callback on limits and levels to a Personal Sender Account holder, the account's age is counted in whole calendar months from the date the account was opened to the callback request date:

| Account age on the callback request date | Business days added to the counted limits callback window |
|---|---|
| fewer than 12 whole months | 2 |
| at least 12 but fewer than 36 whole months | 1 |
| 36 whole months or more | 0 |

When the age is fewer than 12 months, 2 business days are added to the counted limits callback window; when it is at least 12 but fewer than 36 months, 1 business day is added; when it is 36 months or more, nothing is added for the account's age.

## Counting whole months

The opened date on the account record is the starting point. A whole calendar month is complete on the same day of the month as the opened date; a month not yet completed does not count.

Hypothetical dates, for an account opened on 15 March of a given year:

| Callback request date | Whole months | Business days added |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March of the next year | 11 | 2 |
| 15 March of the next year | 12 | 1 |
| 14 March three years after opening | 35 | 1 |
| 15 March three years after opening | 36 | 0 |
